<!-- GENERATED by Scripts/generate-config-reference.py - do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: python3 Scripts/generate-config-reference.py -->

206 keys read by the framework code. Set any of them as `-Dkey=value` on the Maven command line (highest priority), or as `key=value` in `src/test/resources/config/global.properties` (all sites) or `<site>.properties` (one site). Keys read only through `System.getProperty` are JVM `-D` flags only. "Default" is the fallback written in the code; a blank means the code has no literal default (the feature is off, or the key is required where it is used).

The ordinary run flags (`-Dsite`, `-Dbrowser`, `-Dheadless`, `-DsuiteXmlFile`, ...) are in [ALL_COMMANDS.md](../ALL_COMMANDS.md); this page is the complete key list.
